english.note: Use 唔該 as the all-purpose colloquial polite request marker.
Use this casual request marker before an action when kindly means please.

examples.english: Please help me open the door.
examples.jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 hoi1 mun4

examples.english: Could you kindly keep an eye on my seat for me?
examples.jyutping: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 wai2
